target_domains.notes: Still appears active -- may NOT actually be dropping. Website functional as of May 2026.

sushifaq.com.description: Comprehensive sushi FAQ and educational resource. 'The definitive guide to sushi, sashimi, and related Japanese cuisine.' Created by Warren Ransom, a classically trained chef. Covered sushi history, item profiles, nutrition, dining etiquette, how-to-make guides, sustainability, and a blog (Sushi Otaku).
sushifaq.com.last_active: 2024+ (site still resolving to IIS placeholder as of recent check)
key_pages: how to make sushi at home
sushifaq.com.assessment: BEST IN CLASS. This is NOT a restaurant site -- it is a pure content/FAQ site about sushi. Backlinks come from food blogs, educational references, and recipe sites. 769 referring domains over 26 years of content authority. Links are HIGHLY transferable to cooking tools.

lagerhousedetroit.com.description: PJ's Lager House -- Detroit's premier live music venue and bar in historic Corktown. Opened 1914 as a bakery, became a speakeasy during Prohibition. Known for indie/punk/rock shows. NOT primarily a restaurant. Serves pub fare (corned beef, burgers, chicken strips).
lagerhousedetroit.com.assessment: POOR FIT. This is a local music venue, not a food site. DA 53 is attractive but 89 RD is low, and backlinks are from Detroit music press, local news (Metro Times, Deadline Detroit), Yelp, Songkick, Bandsintown. These are LOCAL + MUSIC links, not food/cooking links. Zero transferability to cooking tools. The business also still operates at thelagerhouse.com -- high risk the domain never actually drops or gets contested.

bluedogcafe.com.description: Blue Dog Cafe -- Cajun/Creole restaurant in Lafayette, Louisiana. Founded 1999 by artist George Rodrigue (famous for Blue Dog paintings). Serves crawfish enchiladas, honey-glazed duck, po'boys, shrimp and grits. Art gallery + dining concept.
bluedogcafe.com.last_active: Appears CLOSED as of March 2026 per Yelp
bluedogcafe.com.assessment: MODERATE FIT. Restaurant site, not content site. 251 RD is decent. Backlinks from OpenTable, Yelp, RoadFood, food blogs (The Vintage Fork, The Yums), Wanderlog. Mix of local directory links and food blog links. The food blog links have SOME transferability to cooking content. The Cajun/Creole niche could support a recipe converter angle. Restaurant closing means domain more likely to actually drop.

311restaurantpr.com.description: 311 Trois Cent Onze -- French fine dining restaurant at 311 Fortaleza Street in Old San Juan, Puerto Rico. French/American cuisine with Puerto Rican touches. Upscale, intimate, 4.5-star Yelp rating.
311restaurantpr.com.last_active: Still appears operational based on reservation system
311restaurantpr.com.assessment: POOR FIT. Fine dining restaurant, not food content site. Backlinks are local PR tourism and dining directories. NOT transferable to cooking tools. Restaurant may still be operating -- domain may not drop.

nudelrestaurant.com.description: Nudel Restaurant -- Intimate 29-seat farm-to-table restaurant in Lenox, MA (Berkshires). Now rebranded to 'Cello'. Experimental, seasonal menu featuring German-style egg pasta (spatzle). Chef Bjorn Somlo.
nudelrestaurant.com.last_active: Rebranded to Cello -- domain likely abandoned
nudelrestaurant.com.assessment: MODERATE DOMAIN NAME. The word 'nudel' (German for noodle) has keyword value for pasta/noodle recipes. But 205 RD are local Berkshires press and dining links. Low transferability. The rebranding to Cello means the domain is genuinely abandoned.

guerrameats.com.description: Guerra Quality Meats -- Family butcher shop in San Francisco since 1954. Full-service butcher, catering, Italian deli, prepared foods. Located at 490 Taraval St.
guerrameats.com.last_active: STILL ACTIVE AND OPERATIONAL as of May 2026
guerrameats.com.assessment: SKIP. Business is still operating. Website is still live. Domain is NOT dropping. Even if it were, links are 100% local SF directories and reviews -- zero transferability.

tanjoreharvardsq.com.description: Tanjore Indian Restaurant in Harvard Square, Cambridge, MA. Regional Indian cuisine with lunch buffet. Tandoori, Southern Indian specialties, catering.
tanjoreharvardsq.com.assessment: POOR FIT. Local Indian restaurant. Backlinks from Foursquare, OpenTable, TripAdvisor, local Cambridge press. Zero transferability. Restaurant may still operate -- domain may not drop.

woodysseafood.com.description: Woody's Seafood Saloon -- Island bar/restaurant in Cruz Bay, US Virgin Islands with second location in Charlotte, NC. Known for Shark Bites appetizer, World Famous Happy Hour.
woodysseafood.com.last_active: Appears active in USVI and Charlotte
woodysseafood.com.assessment: POOR FIT. Local seafood bar/restaurant. Backlinks from Yelp, TripAdvisor, travel sites. Zero transferability to cooking tools. Business still operates.

kitchenultimate.com.description: Kitchen Ultimate -- Content site for kitchen equipment reviews and cooking advice. 'Kitchen life simplified.' Reviews of appliances, cookware, cooking techniques.
kitchenultimate.com.assessment: DECENT CONTENT DOMAIN. Kitchen equipment review/blog site. DA 21 is low but 197 RD from content/affiliate links are more transferable than restaurant links. The domain name 'kitchenultimate' has decent keyword relevance. However, DA 21 is below our threshold for meaningful DR boost via cross-linking.

sushifaq.com.food_blog_links: HIGH -- Listed in top 10 sushi blogs by Feedspot. Referenced by foodyholic.com, makesushi.com (partner), sushilinks.com. Educational citations from food education sites.
sushifaq.com.food_community_links: HIGH -- Facebook presence, active Sushi Otaku blog with comment community, Twitter @sushifaq
sushifaq.com.local_news: MINIMAL -- Not a local business, so minimal local press.
sushifaq.com.spam: LOW -- 26-year domain with organic content growth. No signs of PBN or link scheme activity.
sushifaq.com.assessment: EXCELLENT backlink quality. 769 RD over 26 years = organic growth, not spam. Links from food blogs, recipe sites, and educational references are DIRECTLY transferable to cooking tool domains. This is the highest-quality food domain in the batch by a wide margin.

lagerhousedetroit.com.food_blog_links: ZERO -- Not a food content site.
lagerhousedetroit.com.local_news: HIGH -- Deadline Detroit, Metro Times, michigan.org, Detroit local media.
lagerhousedetroit.com.assessment: WRONG NICHE. Despite DA 53, the 89 RD are almost entirely music venue and Detroit local links. Zero food blog or recipe links. These provide no SEO benefit when redirected to cooking tools. The topical mismatch would likely cause Google to discount these links entirely.

bluedogcafe.com.food_blog_links: LOW-MODERATE -- Some food blog coverage (The Vintage Fork, The Yums, RoadFood).
bluedogcafe.com.art_links: MODERATE -- George Rodrigue Blue Dog art references.
bluedogcafe.com.directories: HIGH -- OpenTable, Yelp, Wanderlog, YellowPages, Nextdoor.
bluedogcafe.com.assessment: MIXED. 251 RD but mostly directory and local links. Only 15-20% are food blog links that would transfer well. The Cajun/Creole niche angle is interesting but most links reference the restaurant's art collection, not food content. Moderate transferability at best.

current_state.notes: Two DR 0 domains linking to each other provides negligible SEO benefit. Both domains need INCOMING authority from higher-DR sites.

roi_analysis.verdict: DIMINISHING RETURNS. The extra $75-125 for bluedogcafe adds only ~3 DR points. Most of bluedogcafe's 251 RD are directories that won't transfer much juice through a cross-link chain.

scenario_c.cross_linking_topology: PROBLEMATIC -- lagerhousedetroit.com backlinks are 100% music venue / Detroit local. Cross-linking a Detroit music venue to sushi/cooking tools creates TOPICAL DISSONANCE that Google will likely discount or penalize.

roi_analysis.verdict: WORST ROI. Spending $150+ extra for minimal incremental benefit. Lagerhouse adds nothing. Bluedogcafe adds minimal. Budget better spent on content for owned domains.

roi_analysis.verdict: BEST CLUSTER OPTION if budget allows two domains. Topical relevance of both acquired domains is PERFECT for cooking tools. Cheaper than Scenario B with better link transferability.
